sample_unit: entries (30 each from NHANES, RxNORM, and real-world cases)

links.outcome: LLM medication extraction F1 on mistyped medication names and real-world notes
links.effect: F1-scores of 0.94 on real-world cases and 0.97 on the mistyped dataset; most errors were due to trade names and combined medication names.
links.quote: Applying to real-world cases and mistyped dataset, the LLM-based extraction fared acceptably, with F1-scores of 0.94 and 0.97, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt refinement to optimize LLM medication extraction
Linking extracted medications to DILIrank and LiverTox DILI risk databases using LLM and algorithmic matching

screen.reason: The study develops and feasibility-tests an LLM pipeline to extract medication information from clinical notes for DILI surveillance on offline datasets, focusing on model performance metrics without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
